name: Manticore Tutelage
body:
Your nemean tail positively bristles with spines, and with some training from your manticore lord you can fire twins spines with frightening accuracy.

Prerequisite(s): Nemean, spine shot racial trait.

Benefit(s): The number of spines you may fire per day improves to your Constitution modifier + 1/2 your character level. Additionally, you may fire up to 2 spines with the same attack action. Both spine attacks are made as primary natural attacks, made against up to 2 targets within 30 feet of one another.

Normal: You may only fire a number of spines equal to your Constitution modifier + 1/4 your character level, and you may only fire 1 spine at a time.
